text: A keyword shuffle reads the columns in the alphabetical order of the key's letters. Ten earlier experiments read them in the order of the ranks themselves, a different shuffle (issue #26).
Every puzzle word as the key, once or twice (40,771 shuffles), read the right way, with a repeating secret word or an autokey on either side.
Nothing fits beyond what scrambled coppers show, so the earlier conclusions stand for both readings.
